name: Verify Agentforce tickets can be filtered in reports
objective: Validate that fulfillers can filter and report on tickets created by Agentforce.
precondition: Tickets created by Agentforce exist in the system. Fulfiller has reporting access.

steps.description: Navigate to the ticket reporting/list view
steps.expectedResult: Ticket list or report view is displayed

steps.description: Verify only Agentforce-created tickets are displayed
steps.expectedResult: All displayed tickets have Source = Agentforce; no other tickets are shown
